h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Thanjavur

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Thanjavur

items.pText: Many school and temple-town grounds in Thanjavur have an old neem, rain tree or banyan that gives the only shade on a hot afternoon. Putting play equipment under it seems obvious, but big trees bring their own problems. FunPlay Systems designs and manufactures outdoor playground equipment for schools, parks, hotels and societies in Thanjavur at our factory in Vasai East, about 1,160 km away.

Thanjavur is in the Cauvery delta, the rice-growing heart of Tamil Nadu, and is known for the Brihadeeswarar Temple and its painting tradition. It is hot for most of the year, and most of the rain comes with the north-east monsoon from October to December. We send equipment by road and install it through our own team or a dealer in south India. Send us photos that show where the trees stand, and we will place each piece on a layout drawing with its safe play area.

props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Placing equipment around old shade trees

c: Keep slides, swings and climbers outside the spread of a large tree's branches, where dead wood is most likely to fall. Roots near the surface also make grouting difficult, and digging through them can harm the tree. A few metres out, the equipment still gets shade for part of the day.

Leaves and bird droppings collect on decks and slides under trees, so plan a quick sweep each morning. Have the canopy checked once a year and dead branches removed before the monsoon. Benches can go right under the tree for parents. Not far away, we installed a

items.q: Can playground equipment be placed under a tree?
items.a: It is safer to place it just outside the tree's canopy, where falling branches are less likely to land. The equipment still gets shade for part of the day, and roots are not damaged when the posts are grouted.

items.q: When should we install in Thanjavur?
items.a: Most of Thanjavur's rain falls between October and December, so installing outside those months makes grouting and curing easier. Share your site details early so the layout is approved in time.

items.q: Do you supply hotels and resorts in the Cauvery delta?
items.a: Yes. We have done a resort playground in Dindigul, and we follow the same process for a hotel garden in Thanjavur: site photos, a layout drawing, approval, then manufacture and installation.
